basic_info.description: Enjoy stunning Golden Gate Bridge views from this timelessly elegant, newly remodeled 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condominium perched atop a highly sough-after, prime block in Pacific Heights. The formal entryway leads to an open concept chef's kitchen complete with newly updated quartz countertops and luxury appliances. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining/living space, which features a gas fireplace and stunning floor to ceiling windows. The home offers an encaptivating ambiance, due to the abundance of windows, overlooking the bay and the open concept design philosophy. The bedroom suite offers ample space, while taking advantage of the sweeping views of the bay. This home is ideally located just a stone's throw away from the bustling high-end shops, restaurants and boutiques along Union, Fillmore, and Chestnut Streets. This ultra-desirable property includes a generously proportioned and convenient located deeded parking, along with a massive storage cage, for added convenience. Act quickly, as properties of such a distinct pedigree rarely last.
